name: Copper
one_liner: Copper offers a RESTful API with JSON responses for accessing CRM resources, authenticated via API keys or OAuth2.
auth_notes: Both API keys and OAuth2.0 are supported; API keys are for individual users, OAuth2.0 for partner integrations.
access_notes: API keys can be generated directly in the Copper web app under System settings > API Keys.

extras.rate_limits: All API calls are limited to 180 requests per minute. Once this limit has been reached, calls will return an error response with status code `429`. This rate limit is evaluated on a rolling window basis. Our bulk APIs have an additional rate limit of 3 requests per second.
